# Cache

Step-level caching strategies to skip redundant computation during denoising.

## Overview

- [`BaseCache`](base_cache.md) — Abstract base class for all caches
- [`TeaCache`](teacache.md) — Temporal-Error-Aware cache
- [`DBCache`](dbcache.md) — Delta-Based cache
- [`DCache`](dcache.md) — D-Cache implementation
- [`EasyCache`](easycache.md) — Lightweight step cache
- [`MagCache`](magcache.md) — Magnitude-based cache
